summary: P 2 contains partly verified component facts, with no eligible new degree recommendation. South College official pages conflict at 60%/75%, and transfer information excludes Sophia/StraighterLine; graduate CBE cannot inherit generic undergraduate caps. CBU advertises 541 USD perunit plus fees but 100 transfer-unit marketing conflicts with residence evidence. UW-Parkside BSBA advertises 2250 USD per 12 weeks. Memphis/Saylor, NU/Sophia and RMCAD/Sophia relationships do not prove a degree allocation; pass/fail credit is not traditional letter grading. WGU restrictions remain program-specific. Exact catalog reconciliation, accreditation and at least 50% actual applicable credit remain unverified; retain WATCH and add no speculative mappings.

evidence.title: WGU ACE restrictions are program-specific; no universal new rule established
evidence.quote: Curated observed-source summary (not a verbatim origin quote): Official WGU pathway pages explicitly identify a named program/catalog and provider. They state at least25% of undergraduate competency units must be completed through residency and courses may not satisfy multiple courses of study. The May2026 Sophia BS Supply Chain and Operations Management preview shows55 potential transfer CUs of110required, but duplicate parser rows and preview status mean this is not a newly approved pathway ledger. Other WGU pathways list different potential totals; no university-wide ban or uniform degree-level ACE limit was established. Graduate and undergraduate rules must remain separate. WGU competency units are preserved as CUs; no silent credit-unit conversion is authorized.
evidence.receiptNote: Native connector result retained with the final program packet.
